calculate_permutation_scores: calculate permutation scores for a single column by shuffling its values and measuring score degradation
create_importances_bunch: create a Bunch object with mean, std, and raw permutation importance scores from baseline and permuted scores
weights_scorer: invoke a scorer callable with or without sample weights on a fitted estimator
test_permutation_importance: test the permutation_importance function on a fitted logistic regression estimator with custom scoring
build_feature_importance: build permutation feature importance scores for all columns in a dataset using a fitted sklearn estimator
